folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation: chronology and evidence precedence, 2026-11-04 (B358)
folds.body:
This complete audit is a chronological owner, not a live assignment roster. Later recorded outcomes qualify earlier pending, failed, NOT READY and blocked statements while preserving how those judgments arose. Historical startup/visible sidebar rows, process IDs, API failures, parent requests and queued delivery establish neither present liveness nor a new permission to create or resume workers. Current host routing and one-writer rules govern any new selected work. Original-world content does not require external canon, a dirty tree alone is not a semantic blocker, and a commit is not required merely to assemble a coherent isolated candidate. The old one-realm/prestige gate, old desktop matrix and generic human-acceptance barriers are superseded by current direction and AD42.

**Dependency and ownership:** D1 froze a coherent input set; R3’s learned-herb presentation fix and the estate-label callback were separate after-D1 inputs. Narrow helper/call-site releases never granted general main, inheritance, acquisition or serializer ownership. R3 completion returned its seam; later receiver records distinguish relayed, apply-checked, source-applied and combined-tested inputs. Estate naming preserved kin and real item state, rather than changing inheritance mechanics. A matching original hash, clean patch or successful message delivery alone is not current integration. The later Paradise chart-before-enrollment patch likewise has expected-fail controls, isolated proof, delivery/release and later candidate incorporation as separate stages.

**World research:** W1/W2 and W3/W4 close their finite windows and budgets, not whole sources or all future world behavior. The five world dispositions are dated readiness proposals. REAL/SIM, testimony versus shown behavior, span versus cumulative duration, run-dependent prices/caps and unknown prices remain distinct. Focus-term census can improve a window without establishing semantic absence across every uninspected passage. The later source-gap round corrects earlier window-limited “not found” results. In this audit, the parent’s zero-reader recovery inference was corrected to one 10,821-word reader; its pre-failure versus post-resume timing remains explicitly unresolved. Do not erase that discrepancy or credit source reading from metadata, completion labels or linked locators. Qualified title/edition owners govern the historical B1–B5 shorthand; no new acquisition or source review follows here.

**Pilot and UI evidence:** H1/H2’s unwired module tests, dev-patched frontier proxy, unpatched true-Goa route and legitimate frontier save/reentry proof are separate stages. The later nativePatch fix addresses stale-slice persistence; controlled stamina regeneration and world-time measurements qualify the earlier double-clock concern rather than proving every throw path. The empty seen-list was later attributed to a collapsed/render gate, with its delta patch and owner proof still distinct from adoption into a frozen combined candidate. Lineage’s eventual both-width14/14 result supersedes the unresolved stall; the earlier overlapping browser runs and slow execution did not prove a product defect. Elder-click no-reproduction did not cover the later Begin/Bio/Notebook defects. Subsequent real-pointer proof closes the specifically tested buttons/routes, not every body command, zoom or accessibility state.

**Financial semantics and completion:** keep the sect’s flat annual schedule, another lender’s one-year lump sum, annual installment, accrued interest, remaining principal and total obligation distinct. The historical 1,000-CP sect example is 460 per year for ten years, with the inferred100 principal/360 interest split; a different500-CP lender’s680 due is not evidence for a230 annual sect installment. Source-supported terms, authored calendar/price/body-value dials and the character’s belief about restart debt are separately labeled in the later records. The initial local probe lacked real repay income and used imported time/end-life setup; the final completion adds an authored CP task and atomic repayments. It still does not establish an unwaited second browser interest increment, complete native life ending, every Export surface or an applied heir-carry seam. The unsupported carries claim was removed while drops remained; a displayed carry policy is not actual copying.

**Final integration:** old 2,731/2,749/2,774 totals and cd40e642 evidence belong to their exact combined inputs. Later queued H2, native-kin and LOTM aliases/timing inputs require their actual receiver’s changed-candidate evidence; a tie fixture is not play-created kin. The final real-pointer addendum and Primordial completion are later bounded outcomes, not universal proof that all preceding open gaps are closed. The old mandatory check:rule-behavior wording is not a new universal gate under current AD36. No source corpus, child output, actual present code, current process, gameplay test or screenshot was newly verified by reading this owner, and no patch, worker, build, merge, commit, install or retirement action was performed.
